## 6. Regulatory & Compliance Notice
M. Mohan Rao is an independent Insurance Advisor based in Hosur, Tamil Nadu. This platform operates as an independent advisor guidance portal and is not an official corporate website of LIC, Star Health, or United India Insurance. All insurance policies, terms, conditions, coverage, underwriting, bonuses, and claims are issued, approved, and settled directly by the respective insurance corporations in accordance with IRDAI rules.
